**Methods in Health Data Science with R (MHDSR)** is a live, cohort-based training pathway in applied biostatistics, machine learning, survival analysis, and evidence synthesis, taught in R with reproducible Quarto workflows.

<div class="announcement">
Enrollment is open for the September&ndash;October 2026 cohort. To register, email [elbadisyimad@gmail.com](mailto:elbadisyimad@gmail.com?subject=MHDSR%20-%20Registration%2FInterest) with your name and chosen course(s). [See the full catalogue &rarr;](courses/index.qmd)
</div>

## Programme design

The MHDSR pathway takes participants from applied biostatistics through prediction, time-to-event analysis, and evidence synthesis. **BIOSTATR** gives the foundations: study design, descriptive statistics, inference, regression, survival basics, and reproducible R/Quarto workflows. **ML4HOR** builds on it with prediction, validation, and interpretability. **SURV4CR** extends this to the full time-to-event workflow for clinical research. **METAR** closes the pathway with evidence synthesis and pooled inference across studies.

Each course can be taken independently (no prerequisite is mandatory), but the order above is recommended for participants building comprehensive mastery.

`BIOSTATR` &rarr; `ML4HOR` &rarr; `SURV4CR` &rarr; `METAR`. [Browse the full catalogue, schedule, and pricing &rarr;](courses/index.qmd)
